extract_batch: mixed bytes and URL inputs share one output envelope

import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, ExtractionConfig, UrlExtractionMode, extractBatch } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const config: ExtractionConfig = { url: { mode: UrlExtractionMode.Document } };
  const result = await extractBatch([{ kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, uri: "https://example.com" } as ExtractInput, { bytes: Uint8Array.from([66, 97, 116, 99, 104, 32, 98, 121, 116, 101, 115, 32, 99, 111, 110, 116, 101, 110, 116]), filename: "inline.txt", kind: ExtractInputKind.Bytes, mimeType: "text/plain" } as ExtractInput], config);
  console.log(result.results);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.content);
  console.log(result.results?.[1]?.content);
}

void main();
